claims.promise: Windows ARM64 build finds the vcpkg WebView2 target and links the static loader through CMake.
Session creation initializes COM STA and creates WebView2 environment asynchronously.
Persistent profile uses profilePath as user data folder and invalid profile setup fails explicitly.
Ephemeral profile uses WebView2 InPrivate options and does not silently fall back to persistent storage.
Environment, controller and profile completion use InitializationScheduler, including Ready and Failed results.
Qt attach, detach and resize explicitly control WebView2 controller parent, bounds and visibility.
Host completions are one-shot, weak-owner and UI-thread dispatched for COM operations.
WebView2 navigation events map to policy decisions, stable LoadEvent navigation IDs and explicit external navigation callbacks.
Bridge accepts only current main-frame origin and document token messages and uses JSON APIs.
Custom scheme and WebResourceRequested serve app mappings without rewriting app URLs.
Mapped resources reject traversal, symlink escape, directories and missing files and report unsupported runtime capability explicitly.
Popup deferral transfers accepted child ownership by value and closes rejected or dropped children.
Async downloads support Cancel, BrowserDefault and TargetPath with normalized origin and documentUrl.
Windows FileSelection capability is Unsupported with no JS shim, IFileDialog or backend chooser, and a TODO marker remains.
Windows ARM64 debug and release builds and runtime failure cases are validated with explicit diagnostics.
Public boundaries contain no native types and no dynamic plugin loader, registry or LoadLibrary path exists.
